mechanism: Irbesartan may increase colchicine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and P-glycoprotein inhibition, increasing risk of colchicine toxicity; additionally, both drugs can cause renal impairment which may further elevate colchicine concentrations.
action: Monitor renal function closely; consider colchicine dose reduction or alternative therapy; avoid concurrent use in patients with baseline renal impairment.
